# Roof racks and storage accessories

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Attach a six-foot steel rail, PVC pipe pieces, and a camo tarp to create a roll-up roof rack system. [t939]

[Partial] Select a rounded head carriage bolt, then cut felt to cushion it against the roof rack. [t940]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Select a rounded head carriage bolt for the mounting point.
2. Cut or tear felt material intended for furniture feet into small pieces.

_Procedure reported by [t940]._

## Tips & gotchas

- Chop off the extra bolt on the steel rail to allow for rolling up and strapping down the tarp. [t939]
- Add more grommets to the tarp if three per side is insufficient. [t939]
- [Partial] Use zip ties to attach the cut PVC piece to the tarp, adding two sets of grommets on one side for better distribution. [t939]
- Note that zip ties may not be a permanent solution compared to other fasteners. [t939]
- Set up the assembled frame to test functionality before finalizing all components like paracord and stakes. [t939]
- Roll up the entire assembly when not in use for compact storage on the roof rack. [t939]
- Use the felt to cushion between the bolt head and the roof rack surface. [t940]
